Maplelane Capital Increases Stake in Nvidia (Put) (NVDA); Graham Capital Management LP Holding in Amazon Com (AMZN) Cut by $305,106
June 17, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Leon Shaulov increased its stake in Nvidia Corp (Put) (NVDA) by 53.61% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Maplelane Capital Llc bought 44,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.09% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Leon Shaulov held 127,500 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $29.53 million, up from 83,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Maplelane Capital Llc who had been investing in Nvidia Corp (Put) for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $161.01B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.62% or $1.65 during the last trading session, reaching $265.26. About 9.08 million shares traded. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has risen 80.30% since June 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 67.73% the S&P500. Kenneth Tropin decreased its stake in Amazon Com Inc (AMZN) by 24.03% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC.
